profile: descent direction: A descent direction is a direction vector in the input space that stems from a point w0 and points toward a new point w1 with a lower function evaluation. The first-order Taylor approximation, being a hyperplane, conveniently provides a descent direction, as used in gradient descent. Some optimization methods naturally determine high quality descent directions at a cost often cheaper than coordinate-wise approaches.
